name: tubulin gamma complex component 4

function.text: TUBGCP4 is the approved symbol for tubulin gamma complex component 4. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in gamma-tubulin binding; structural constituent of cytoskeleton; cytoplasmic microtubule organization.

germline.text: Retained strong or definitive GenCC associations include microcephaly and chorioretinopathy 3 (autosomal recessive). Allele and inheritance require review.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Esophageal carcinoma; Head and neck squamous cell carcinoma; Lung adenocarcinoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

function.text: TUBGCP4 encodes tubulin gamma complex component 4. Its functions include gamma-tubulin binding and structural constituent of cytoskeleton.

germline.text: Germline disease associations include microcephaly and chorioretinopathy 3 (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TUBGCP4 have been reported in lung adenocarcinoma, esophageal carcinoma, and prostate adenocarcinoma.
